target_customer: Wellness platforms, mental health apps, coaching services and healthcare intake teams that embed AI chat and voice agents
problem: Care and wellness providers spend staff time on patient intake and between-session support that conversational agents could handle.
business_model: Custom AI agent development and deployment for B2B platforms, pricing not public
product_category: Conversational AI agents for healthcare intake and wellness

founders.name: Vinith Johnson
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a cognitive neuroscience researcher at Neuroscape on digital therapeutics for ADHD and tech lead on a cervical dystonia adaptive deep brain stimulation trial. CB Insights lists UCSF Health and IBM instead, which was not confirmed. Education not found.

competitors.name: DexCare
competitors.what: Patient access and digital intake platform for health systems

competitors.name: Health Note
competitors.what: Pre-visit clinical intake automation that drafts notes for providers
competitors.funding_then: 17 million USD Series A reported 2022-07, a few months after the batch

technical_complexity.rationale: Building reliable clinical intake agents in 2022 required NLP and healthcare data handling, but a solo founder could prototype with off the shelf language models.

defensibility.rationale: Chat and voice agents on third party models are easy to replicate, and no customers, data or integrations are named.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Intake funding went to rivals such as Health Note and later MiiHealth AI. No acquisition of Sophys found.

market_need_then: Healthcare intake funding in 2022 (DexCare 50 million USD in January, Health Note 17 million USD in July) signals investor demand, but no direct customer evidence for Sophys was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses sophyshealth.com, a Health suffix, not the exact sophys.com

identity.voice_and_tone: Empathetic AI companion messaging for wellness

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found; only directory listings.

pivots.from: AI agents for healthcare intake (YC description)
pivots.to: AI agents for wellness, mental health apps and coaching (company site)
pivots.why: Not stated. Date unknown; inferred from the difference between the YC description and the current site.

outcome_analysis: Sophys is a one person company listed as active, with the current site pitching custom AI agents to wellness and mental health platforms rather than clinical intake. No funding beyond the YC deal, named customers or press was found, so traction is unknown. Rivals in intake raised much larger rounds during 2022. The record shows a solo technical founder with a clinical research background and an unproven market position.
notes: Unverified: CB Insights lists a 500K convertible note on 2022-03-30 with Y Combinator as investor, a single aggregator, probably the standard YC deal, so not recorded as a round. No shutdown or acquisition news found. Sources disagree on the product (intake, billing, coding, wellness). Update: the 500K convertible note dated 2022-03-30 is now recorded from CB Insights (Extruct dates it 2022-03-29 as pre-seed); it is likely the standard YC deal and rests on databases only.
